tool_input.command:
export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec112/fx" && cd -- "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && [ "$(pwd -P)" = "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] && PLUGIN_ROOT="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/plugins/system-spec-harness" && python3 -c "
import json;d=json.load(open('system-spec/spec-state.json'))
print('schema',d.get('schema_version'),d.get('design_application_contract_version'))
print('hp',d.get('hearing_progress'))
print('targets',[t.get('target_id') for t in d.get('targets',[])])
print('decisions',[(x.get('id'),x.get('status')) for x in d.get('decisions',[])])
print('foundation confirmed',d['requirements_foundation'].get('confirmed'),d['requirements_foundation'].get('approval_ref'))
print('qa',len(d['qa_log']),'appr',len(d.get('approval_log',[])))
import collections;c=collections.Counter(cell['state'] for cat in d['matrix'].values() for cell in (cat.values() if isinstance(cat,dict) else []) if isinstance(cell,dict) and 'state' in cell);print(c)
print(list(d.keys()))
"; python3 "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/validate-knowledge-graph.py" --profile required-info --input "$PLUGIN_ROOT/skills/run-system-spec-elicit/references/required-info-catalog.json" --state "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/system-spec/spec-state.json" | python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print({k:v for k,v in d.items() if k!='collection_order'}.get('coverage_certificate'))"; echo ri_exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; python3 "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/validate-design-knowledge-refs.py" --matrix "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/system-spec/spec-state.json" --repo-root "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; echo dk_exit=$?
